emails.body:
Dear SETU Counselling Centre team,

I give a free 45-minute online talk for students called "Your Brain vs AI": how attention and memory actually work, what leaning on AI does to thinking (based on published studies, stated honestly), and five simple habits that help with focus and memory during exams. Warm regards,
Manish Kumar Singh
